description: This source file defines data models for an IPL team analytics API, using Pydantic for data validation and serialization. It contains class definitions for various team metrics, summaries, top players, boundary analysis, run rate breakdowns, wicket types, seasonal performance, and head-to-head statistics, primarily serving as data schemas for API responses.

classes.name: TeamColors
classes.description: Represents the primary and secondary colors of a team, with hex code strings.

classes.name: Team
classes.description: Contains metadata about an IPL team, including code, name, and colors.

classes.name: TeamListResponse
classes.description: Response schema containing a list of all teams.

classes.name: TeamKpisBoundaries
classes.description: Aggregated boundary counts: fours, sixes, total boundaries.

classes.name: DotBallKpi
classes.description: KPI data for dot balls, including count and percentage.

classes.name: TeamKpis
classes.description: Detailed KPIs for a team, including match stats, outcomes, scoring, and wickets.

classes.name: TeamOverviewResponse
classes.description: Summary response combining team metadata and KPIs.

classes.name: TopBatter
classes.description: Leaderboard entry for a top batter, including runs, balls, strike rate, and boundaries.

classes.name: TopBowler
classes.description: Leaderboard entry for a top bowler, including wickets, overs, economy, etc.

classes.name: TopBattersResponse
classes.description: Response containing top batters for a team.

classes.name: TopBowlersResponse
classes.description: Response containing top bowlers for a team.

classes.name: BoundaryByOver
classes.description: Boundary counts (fours and sixes) in a specific over.

classes.name: BoundaryAnalysis
classes.description: Summary statistics for boundary counts and accuracy percentages.

classes.name: BoundaryAnalysisResponse
classes.description: Response detailing boundary analysis per team, including per-over data.

classes.name: PhaseRunRate
classes.description: Run rate for specific phases or segments of an innings.

classes.name: RunRatePerOver
classes.description: Run rate for individual overs.

classes.name: RunRateBreakdownResponse
classes.description: Overall run rate breakdown by phases and over series.

classes.name: WicketTypeRow
classes.description: Breakdown of wicket types and their share percentages.

classes.name: WicketTypesResponse
classes.description: Response containing wicket type breakdowns.

classes.name: YearValue
classes.description: Metric value associated with a specific year.

classes.name: DotBallStatsResponse
classes.description: Response with dot ball KPI and yearly trend.

classes.name: YearlyPerformanceRow
classes.description: Aggregated team performance data per season.

classes.name: YearlyPerformanceResponse
classes.description: Season-by-season performance summary.

classes.name: HeadToHeadRow
classes.description: Head-to-head stats vs specific opponents.

classes.name: HeadToHeadResponse
classes.description: Full head-to-head comparison data.
